raw_text: Establishing a process to identify, assess, and manage cybersecurity risks associated with third parties prior to engagement.
Ensuring that cybersecurity requirements are explicitly included in contracts and agreements with third parties.
Conducting periodic cybersecurity audits and assessments on third parties to ensure compliance with agreed-upon requirements.
Evaluating and selecting cloud service providers based on their ability to meet the organization's cybersecurity requirements and applicable national regulations.
Ensuring data sovereignty requirements are met when hosting data in cloud environments.
Developing, approving, and implementing a cybersecurity resilience strategy that aligns with the organization's Business Continuity Management (BCM).
Identifying critical business functions and determining the Maximum Tolerable Downtime (MTD) and Recovery Time Objective (RTO) for associated information systems.
Testing the disaster recovery plan periodically (at least annually) to ensure critical systems and business operations can be recovered within the agreed RTO.
Implementing secure software development life cycle (SSDLC) practices for all business and web applications developed internally or externally.
Deploying Web Application Firewalls (WAF) to protect critical web and business applications from common web-based attacks.
Ensuring sensitive data processed by business applications (e.g., financial data, PII) is encrypted in transit and at rest.
